t: This is Dolphin Square, a large estate of private flats near the Thames in Pimlico. It was built between 1935 and 1937, and until Highbury Square came along it was the largest garden square in Greater London built as private housing. Some notable residents are linked to it. Anne, the Princess Royal, lived here. So did Sir George Bolton, a banker known for his foreign exchange expertise and his part in London's rebuilding after the Second World War. The Conservative politician Iain Mills died here in 1997.
